notes.title: Future Developments + Another Game
notes.notes:
Hi all,

It has been awhile since our Greenlight campaign that saw Who Is Mike greenlit, for that, we at Fervent would thank you again.

Response has been positive so far and we are heartened by your support! Does this mean that this is the end of Who Is Mike and Fervent?

The answer is no, to both questions.

We are currently waiting for our voice acting to be completed, which is taking rather long, hence, why we decided to release the game first.

Next, we do have several translated versions of Who Is Mike, we are currently going through the process of updating it gradually and I will be letting all of you know through the announcement platform as well as our social media platforms - Please follow us on Twitter, Tumblr and like us on Facebook!

Also, in the coming days, we will be bringing another free to play product to the Greenlight process, this game is called Cupid and is already available for download off our Tumblr - However, we will be putting it on the Steam store to bring our game to a bigger audience.

Thank you once again for all of your support!
